_doc: Overworld trainers. party = [[species, level], ...]; a species '@flag' is read from Game.flags at battle time (the Route 22 rival's starter). class = a GameState.TRAINER_PAYOUTS key; sight = metres (0 = never spots you, talk to fight); sprite is a sheet in assets/sprites/ in the 3x4 npc_*.png layout. Display name on banners = '<CLASS> <NAME>' (see Trainers.display_name). Real trainers: FRLG data from the Bulbapedia references only. Optional fields: display_name (full banner name, overrides <CLASS> <NAME>), reward (exact FRLG prize, overrides base x level), intro/defeat/after/lose lines, requires_flag / hidden_by_flag, scripted (loss does not white-out), arena [w, d] + center (a scene marker name) for gym battles, arena_color (the ground decal tint, stone grey in the gym), ai_think_scale, badge (awarded on win + '<badge>_badge' flag), done_flag / won_flag (set after any/winning battle), doubles (2x2 battle when the player has two healthy: Batalha Viva; gyms always), leave_after + leave_to [x, z] (the trainer walks off and is freed).

test_youngster.name: TEST
intro: (test) Let's battle!
after: (test) I've already been beaten.

bug_catcher_rick.name: Rick
intro: Hey! You have POKéMON! Come on, let's battle!
defeat: No! CATERPIE can't take any more!
after: Shh! You'll scare the bugs away. Maybe another time, okay?

bug_catcher_doug.name: Doug
intro: Hey! POKéMON TRAINERS never run from a battle!
after: Darn! I'm going to go catch some stronger ones!

bug_catcher_anthony.name: Anthony
intro: I may be small, but don't you dare go easy on me!
after: There goes part of my allowance...

bug_catcher_charlie.name: Charlie
intro: Did you know that POKéMON evolve?
after: BUG POKéMON evolve quickly. They're a lot of fun!

bug_catcher_sammy.name: Sammy
intro: Hey, wait up! What's the hurry?
defeat: I give up! You're good at this!
after: Sometimes you can find things on the ground.
I'm looking for something I dropped. Can you help?

camper_liam.name: Liam
intro: Stop right there, kid!
You're ten thousand light-years away from challenging BROCK!
defeat: A light-year isn't a measure of time... It measures distance!
after: You're good... But not as good as BROCK!

brock.name: Brock
intro: So, you're here. I'm BROCK. I'm PEWTER's GYM LEADER.
My rock-hard willpower shows even in my POKéMON.
My POKéMON are as hard as rock, and they have determination to spare.
That's right: my POKéMON are all the ROCK type!
Ha ha! You'll challenge me even though you know you'll lose?
It's your TRAINER's honor that compels you to challenge me.
Very well! Show me your best!
defeat: I took you for granted, and so I lost.
As proof of your victory, I confer on you this: the official POKéMON LEAGUE BOULDERBADGE.
after: There are all kinds of TRAINERS in this huge world of ours.
You appear to be very talented as a POKéMON TRAINER.
Let me give you a suggestion.
Go to the CERULEAN GYM and test your skills.
badge_speech: Just having the BOULDERBADGE makes your POKéMON stronger.
It also lets you use the move FLASH outside of battle.
Of course, the POKéMON must know FLASH to use it.
gift_speech: A TM, or TECHNICAL MACHINE, contains a technique for POKéMON.
Using a TM teaches the move inside it to a POKéMON.
It hurls rocks at the foe and lowers its SPEED.

misty.name: Misty
gate_line: Hold on! You can't challenge me yet.
Beat my TWO trainers first, then come back and show me what you can do.
intro: Hi, you're a new face!
Only TRAINERS who have a strategy with POKéMON can become pros.
What's your strategy for catching and training POKéMON?
Mine is an all-out attack with WATER-type POKéMON!
defeat: Take the CASCADEBADGE as proof that you beat me.
after: Whoever trains with water learns to go with the flow.
Keep it up. You've got real talent.
badge_speech: The CASCADEBADGE makes all POKéMON up to Lv. 30 obey you.
That includes the ones you got in trades.
And there's more: you can now use CUT whenever you like, even outside of battle.
With CUT you can chop down small trees and open new paths.

rival_blue_route22.name: Blue
intro: {RIVAL}: Hey! {PLAYER}!
Heading to the POKéMON LEAGUE? Forget it!
I bet you don't even have any BADGES, do you?
The guard won't let you through without them.
By the way, have your POKéMON gotten any stronger?
lose: {RIVAL}: Yeah! Am I great or what?
after: I hear the POKéMON LEAGUE is full of strong TRAINERS.
I have to figure out how to get past them.
And you, quit stalling and move along!

lass_janice.name: Janice
intro: Excuse me! You looked at me, didn't you?
after: If you don't want to battle, don't stare at me!

bug_catcher_colton.name: Colton
intro: Hey! I saw you in VIRIDIAN FOREST!
after: There are other kinds of POKéMON besides the ones that live in forests.

youngster_ben.name: Ben
intro: Hi! I love shorts!
They're so comfy and easy to wear!
after: Do you use the PC at the POKéMON CENTER to store your POKéMON?
Each BOX holds up to 30 POKéMON.

bug_catcher_greg.name: Greg
intro: You're a TRAINER? Then let's get to it!
defeat: If I'd had fresh POKéMON, I would've won!
after: If a PC BOX fills up, just switch to another one.

youngster_calvin.name: Calvin
intro: Hey! You're not wearing shorts! What's wrong with you?
defeat: I lost! I lost! I lost!
after: I wear shorts all the time, even in winter. It's my rule.

lass_sally.name: Sally
intro: That look you gave me... It's so intriguing!
after: You can avoid battles by not letting TRAINERS see you.

bug_catcher_james.name: James
intro: I'm going to battle with the POKéMON I just caught.
after: Trained POKéMON are stronger than wild ones.

lass_robin.name: Robin
intro: Ouch! Did you just touch me?
after: ROUTE 4 is at the foot of MT. MOON.

lass_iris.name: Iris
intro: What? I'm waiting for my friends to find me here.
after: I came because I heard there are very rare fossils here.

bug_catcher_robby.name: Robby
intro: To get to CERULEAN, you have to go through this cave.
after: ZUBAT is tough to beat! But if you catch one, you can count on it.

super_nerd_jovan.name: Jovan
intro: What?! Don't sneak up on me like that!
after: I need to find stronger POKéMON. Where could they be?

lass_miriam.name: Miriam
intro: Wow! It's way bigger in here than I thought!
after: How do you get out of here? It's so big I could get lost.

bug_catcher_kent.name: Kent
intro: There are some shady men in the cave. And who are you?
after: I saw them! I'm sure they're from TEAM ROCKET!

youngster_josh.name: Josh
intro: Did you come to explore the cave too?
after: I came all the way down here just to show off for the girls.

hiker_marcos.name: Marcos
intro: WHOA! You startled me! ... Oh, it's just a kid!
after: Kids like you shouldn't wander around here in the dark.

rocket_1.name: Grunt
intro: We, TEAM ROCKET, will find those fossils! Reviving POKéMON from them will make us rich!
after: You've made me furious! TEAM ROCKET will put you on the blacklist!

rocket_2.name: Grunt
intro: We, TEAM ROCKET, are the POKéMON gangsters! We spread fear with our strength!
after: Dang it! My buddies won't let this slide!

rocket_3.name: Grunt
intro: We're on a big job here! Scram, kid!
after: If you find a fossil, hand it over and get lost!

rocket_4.name: Grunt
intro: Kids shouldn't mess with grown-ups! You could get hurt!
after: POKéMON lived here long before people showed up.

super_nerd_miguel.name: Miguel
intro: Hey, stop! I found these fossils! Both of them are mine!
after: Far away from here, on CINNABAR ISLAND, there's a POKéMON LAB.
They research how to revive fossils there.

swimmer_luis.name: Luis
intro: Splash! I'm first! Let's go!
after: MISTY is a TRAINER who just keeps getting better. She won't lose to someone like you!

picnicker_diana.name: Diana
intro: What? You? I'm more than enough for you!
MISTY won't even have to bother.
after: You have to face other TRAINERS to see if you're really good.
